app.name: Meshtastic
app.long_description: The real Meshtastic firmware (2.8.1, portduino) running natively on the Wii with a USB Meshtoad (SX1262 over CH341). MeshtasticUI on the TV: point and press A to tap, + = Enter, B = home, Home quits. Offline maps from sd:/apps/meshtasticd/maps. Phone apps connect over Wi-Fi on TCP port 4403 (tcp_api=0 in config.txt turns it off). Settings in config.txt.
